title: The system scan warns when a long Windows data path will break package loading
user_story: As the owner I want to be told when the data folder is too long for Windows' 260-character limit, instead of packages failing with WinError 206 (live run 2026-10-28; agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md A10).

requirements.description: On Windows with long paths off, a data folder that leaves less than 180 characters below 260 gives a 'Paths' warning in the system scan and at startup, with the length, WinError 206, a shorter folder example and how to enable long paths.
No warning with long paths on, a short folder, or another operating system; nothing is moved or changed.

scenarios.expected: Warning with length, WinError 206, a short folder example and LongPathsEnabled = 1
No warning when long paths are on or the folder is short
An unreadable registry setting counts as off
Only the active project's folder is read; nothing is changed
The check is a string length and one registry read (all 5 tests in milliseconds)

recovery: Fix at sysinfo.long_paths; never change system settings or move data. TASK-LONG-PATHS-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Disposable config (tests/_env.py); platform and registry value patched; evidence in docs/qa/evidence/long-paths-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 5 tests on b440881, all failing (no long-path check). GREEN: 5/5.
